source.title: Forebears Kenya forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Kenyan name pool refreshed against public frequency tables. Gender buckets remain sample-level because they are not sourced from an official civil registry.

source.title: Communications Authority of Kenya Telecommunication Numbering Plan, April 2024

phones.notes: The official numbering plan confirms country code +254, nine-digit mobile/non-geographic national significant numbers, and the listed NDCs. Generated numbers are synthetic and are not checked for live assignment or portability.

locations.notes: UPU confirms Kenya uses five-digit post office codes in postal addressing. Dataset prefixes are stable test placeholders for generated postal codes and are not validated against the full Posta Kenya post-office code table.

passport.label: Passport

source.title: Kenya Directorate of Immigration passport application requirements

passport.notes: Kenya Immigration confirms ordinary passport issuance requirements and use of national ID in adult applications, but not a public passport-number grammar. The A plus seven digits template remains a synthetic placeholder.

national_id_card_number.label: National ID Card Number

source.title: Kenya National Registration Bureau eCitizen service

national_id_card_number.notes: Official NRB source confirms mandatory identification, registration and identity-card issuance for adult citizens, but no public number grammar, checksum or allocation rule was found. The eight-digit template is a legacy-compatible synthetic placeholder only.
